title: Counting equilibria of the Kuramoto model using birationally invariant intersection index

sections.coverage: Root-count problem; Kuramoto ODE and gauge-fixed real equilibrium system (1)–(2); complex Laurent reformulation (3); BI intersection-index spaces (4); chain of claimed topology-sensitive bounds; roadmap and scope.

Constructs the rooted-tree ancestor-exponent monomial map; triangular unimodular exponent matrix preserves torus roots and local structure; sends each parent-edge ratio to yi, making the AP a free sum of n length-two segments with normalized volume 2^n.

Inductively eliminates a leaf equation by a stated linear combination, giving an equivalent parent-edge system; under the monomial map it becomes n independent scalar equations. The source's printed p. 7 quadratic omits y_i multiplying omega_i*, whereas multiplying equation (9) gives the distinct derived quadratic; the card records both literally. sections.unit: §5 Cycle graphs: adjacency polytope and Proposition 12
sections.coverage: Unimodularly maps the cycle adjacency polytope to the centrally symmetric polytope with vertices ±ei and ±sum(ei); treats odd N via the simplicial del Pezzo polytope; explicitly lists even-N facets and proves the facet list is exhaustive.

Counts even-N facets, reduces one facet to an affine free-sum decomposition, computes its normalized volume N/2, and combines with odd-N facet data to obtain AP volume N binom(N−1,floor((N−1)/2)); p. 10 contains a G1/G2 label inconsistency isolated in the card.

For each nonzero initial direction, connectedness propagates negative support minima and prevents both opposing edge monomials from appearing; generic independent initial coefficients and Bernstein's criterion give the exact BKK and BI intersection-index count equal to the AP bound.
